title: Get around the calendar: days, view, calendars and settings
summary: Change the day, jump to a date, choose the view, the zoom and the visible calendars.

steps.title: Menu → Appointments
steps.details: The calendar shows appointments by room and doctor.

steps.title: Previous and next
steps.details: Go forward or back a day, a week or a month depending on the view.

steps.title: Go to a date
steps.details: Click the date to pick a day on the calendar.

steps.title: Calendars
steps.details: Shows or hides the calendars panel: choose which room to view.

steps.title: View
steps.details: Day, several days, week, month or list, and which calendars are shown.

steps.title: Zoom
steps.details: Makes the time slots bigger or smaller.

steps.title: Refresh
steps.details: Reloads the appointments (in case someone booked from somewhere else).

steps.title: Export calendar to Excel
steps.details: Downloads a period's appointments to Excel.

steps.title: Calendar settings
steps.details: Visible hours, slot duration, how an appointment is created (dialog or card) and grouping.
